events.what: VandeBogert and Walker prove a stronger form of the Total Rank Conjecture for rings of characteristic two
Explicit counterexamples to a local variant of Buchsbaum-Eisenbud-Horrocks introduced by Lima-Pereira, Nuno-Ballesteros, Orefice-Okamoto and Tomazella
Rethlas AI system resolves open problems from Cahen-Fontana-Frisch-Glaz and Erman-Sam lists, none among the homological conjectures
events.ai_basis: reported to have resolved several open problems in commutative ring theory and Boij-Soderberg theory fully autonomously with human verification

judgement.doubts: The only candidate event (VandeBogert-Walker) fails twice: its first written argument is the May 2023 v1, and the record does not show new mathematics in the April 2024 v2 (F7); and the Total Rank Conjecture is, by the record's own account, not one of the conjectures the bullet's article lists and not a restriction of any of them (variant). Even under the broad umbrella reading it would be a pre-snapshot case, not post-snapshot movement. The direct summand / big CM algebra resolutions (2016-2018) are pre-snapshot cases of a multi-part bullet, not a whole resolution, so not open_stale. Hochster's 2024 'Thirteen Open Questions' PDF was not read.

corrections.why: F7/F2: the record says VandeBogert-Walker's 'v1 (May 2023) predates the window'; only the v2 revision and journal date fall after, with no new mathematics shown. The record also states the Total Rank Conjecture 'is not one of the 14 conjectures' and 'is a genuinely different statement ... rather than a restriction of any of the 14' — a variant. No surviving post-snapshot event; the competing_reading was right.
F14: open carries null direction; 'confirmed' was also wrong on the original progress row.
other: record finds 'no true movement on any of the 14 listed conjectures' after 26 January 2024.
